title: Running and exporting
Running and exporting
text: exportAsPFB() runs query writes PFB file single call: PFB export requires Python picsure[pfb] optional dependency. Python env provisioned without , exportAsPFB() raises picsureError pointing install hint. exportCSV() exportTSV() serialize R data.frame — typical flow run query first write result: three export functions return path invisibly, can chain:
code: picsure::exportAsPFB(bdc, full_query, "~/cohort.pfb") df <- picsure::runQuery(bdc, full_query, type = "participant") picsure::exportCSV(bdc, df, "~/cohort.csv") picsure::exportTSV(bdc, df, "~/cohort.tsv") pfb_path <- picsure::exportAsPFB(bdc, full_query, tempfile(fileext = ".pfb"))
